projectServices.spec.needService: The service item needs a service: name, start command, port (working directory, environment variables, health check, autostart and web page as needed)
projectServices.spec.cwdMissing: Working directory {dir} doesn't exist (or isn't a folder): create it first, or use an existing folder
projectServices.spec.portTaken: Port {port} is already used by {holder}: pick another one
projectServices.rollout.notLinked: Ergo wasn't started by LSM (not connected to LSM), so it can't bring the service online for you: register it in LSM by hand, or start Ergo through LSM and it'll catch up automatically
projectServices.rollout.unsupported: This LSM version doesn't support owned services, so register it in LSM by hand (Ergo catches up automatically after LSM is upgraded and restarted)
projectServices.rollout.withdrawNotLinke: Ergo isn't connected to LSM right now, so it can't take the service down: remove {app} in LSM by hand (lsm owned remove)
projectServices.rollout.withdrawUnsuppor: This LSM version doesn't support owned services, so it can't be taken down: remove it in LSM by hand
projectServices.outage.offline: It's stopped in LSM (someone may have stopped it there)
projectServices.outage.missing: It's no longer registered in LSM (someone may have removed it there)
projectServices.outage.starting: It never came up (still starting in LSM)
projectServices.outage.stopping: It never stopped or came back up (stopping in LSM)
projectServices.means.label: The project's own service (registered in LSM)
projectServices.entry.url: Service “{title}” of project “{project}”: entry {url} (opens in Ergo's built-in browser)
projectServices.power.notInUse: Project “{name}” isn't in use, so there are no services to start or shut down
projectServices.power.noServices: Project “{name}” has no services online, so there's nothing to start or shut down
projectServices.power.lsm.waiting: Can't reach LSM; try again once it's connected
projectServices.power.lsm.unsupported: This LSM version doesn't support owned services, so Ergo can't start or shut them down for you: do it in LSM
projectServices.power.lsm.disabled: Ergo wasn't started by LSM (not linked), so it can't start or shut down services for you: do it in LSM
projectServices.power.stopFailed: LSM didn't stop it (no reason given)
projectServices.tool.switch: Start or shut down project services
